sys_script_include.description: Owns the x_gegis_ins_policy_loa_evaluation lifecycle only: creates the next evaluation header row for a submission_line, copying LOA's OWN pre-existing versioning convention (version integer + active boolean, NOT the is_latest boolean UWGuidelineVersionService uses for the newer table) rather than forcing the newer shape onto it. Translates a shared uw_trigger_reason code onto loa_evaluation's own local evaluation_trigger choice list (see the CODE_TO_EVALUATION_TRIGGER comment). Does not populate the evaluation RESULT columns (authority_tier, is_authorized, checks_count, breach_count, decision, decided_by/on) - a future evaluation flow's job.
sys_script_include.name: LOAEvaluationVersionService
